title: ARC cell_recall admit ceiling: the prior cell_recall arm ran at threshold 0.5 against a maximum achievable 0.0476, so its 0-plans result is VOID; a 0.20 gate admits 2 engines on 2 games, at which no p<0.05 is reachable
inference_substrate_note: CPU only. No GGUF load, no GPU, no llama-server, no generator, no episode played. This is a recount of cached per-cell JSON plus a static read of arc_competition_agent.py / arc_executable_world_model.py.
solve_provenance_note: No level was solved and no solve is claimed. This is a gate-margin census over an already-recorded corpus.
verifier_is_oracle_note: No verifier-value or moat claim is made. The subject IS the trust gate, not a verifier competing with an oracle.

model_specs.note: no model invoked; margins are read from cached 2026-07-27 cells

no_shipped_default_changed_note: Read-only analysis. No env flag flipped, no default changed, no source edited.
no_p_value_by_design: This is a census of a fixed corpus with no treatment and no pairing. The only probability statement made is the PRE-REGISTERED minimum REACHABLE p implied by the admitted-game count, stated in advance of any effect being measured.

provenance.nothing_tracked_is_written: Reads results/first_win_llm_on_20260727/cells (EVIDENCE, read-only) and writes exactly one new file, this artifact.

prior_art_built_on.what_it_already_answered: the gate is BINDING and mechanically reached (callee-instrumented plan_in_model, caller read off the stack), and clearing it is NECESSARY NOT SUFFICIENT (a gate-clearing engine with an unreachable goal planned nothing).
prior_art_built_on.what_this_artifact_CORRECTS_in_it: its `so_a_threshold_relaxation_is_not_the_lever` cites the llm_on_fix_cellrecall arm's 0 plans as evidence against the metric lever. That arm could not have admitted anything. The citation is void and the sub-claim must be withdrawn -- see PRIOR_ARM_FORENSICS.

prior_art_built_on.what_it_already_answered: the GENERATION-WALL verdict; its LIVE_comparison_the_actual_rejection_set reports the same 28 plain-branch margins used here.
prior_art_built_on.what_this_artifact_CORRECTS_in_it: its plain-branch rule-of-three upper bound 0.1015 is computed at ENGINE level (n=28) while the 28 engines span only 14 distinct GAMES. At the game level the bound is 3/14 = 0.2143, i.e. ~2.1x looser.

prior_art_built_on.what_it_already_answered: GAP-WM-TRUST-GATE / GAP-WM-TRUST-GATE-HIDDEN-STATE: the change gate and its coverage hole; also records that cell_recall masks to TRUE changes only and is therefore recall, blind to a spurious writer.

PRIOR_ARM_FORENSICS.question: what threshold did llm_on_fix_cellrecall actually run at?

the_threshold_is_a_hardcoded_literal.text: elif _gate_value < 0.5:  # too weak to trust for execution-grounded planning
the_threshold_is_a_hardcoded_literal.comment: CARNOT_ARC_TRUST_METRIC chooses WHICH quantity is compared (vr.cell_recall vs vr.accuracy). The 0.5 it is compared AGAINST is a literal in the same expression. Switching the metric moves the quantity onto a different scale and leaves the bar where it was.

no_threshold_env_exists_anywhere_in_the_.search_is_the_evidence: this list is a regex sweep of the file, not an assertion; it is empty of THRESH names, so no override existed to be set.

PRIOR_ARM_FORENSICS.what_must_be_retracted: 'the cell_recall metric that WOULD separate it already shipped as a flag and already ran as an arm (llm_on_fix_cellrecall): still 0 plans installed'. That arm ran a 0.0476-maximum quantity against a 0.5 bar. Zero plans was the only arithmetically possible outcome, so it is not evidence about the lever in either direction. The cell_recall lever HAS NEVER BEEN TESTED at a threshold it could clear. Stating this in the other direction with equal force: this is NOT a finding that the lever works -- it is a finding that the question is OPEN where the record said CLOSED.
PRIOR_ARM_FORENSICS.scope_of_the_retraction: One leg of the GENERATION-WALL verdict. The verdict's other legs -- 0 of 250 on the gate-faithful split, 0 of 15 strongest engines generalising, the hidden-state branch's own 0 of 22 -- are untouched by this and are NOT retracted here.

NONDEGENERACY_CONJUNCT.question: does the cell_recall path carry `correct_changed_cells >= 1`?
NONDEGENERACY_CONJUNCT.answer_in_one_line: NO -- and the premise that it might is itself worth correcting. The two live in MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE branches of an if/elif, so they can never both bind. Turning the change gate ON does not ADD nondegeneracy to the cell_recall gate; it makes CARNOT_ARC_TRUST_METRIC a DEAD LEVER, because `_gate_value` is then never read.

excerpt: elif _gate_value < 0.5:  # too weak to trust for execution-grounded planning
# REQ-ARC-FCP-5699-38 (plain single-shot path): found via the same post-submission

record_evidence.reading: every plain rejection is labelled world_model_accuracy_below_threshold, which is written ONLY by the elif. Not one is labelled world_model_change_gate_*. The threshold branch is the branch that fired.
record_evidence.reading_2: 0 of 28. The diagnostics projection never persisted correct_changed_cells on the plain branch, so the conjunct is not even OBSERVABLE there from these records -- another reason the 16/22 figure cannot be about this branch.

the_16_of_22_belongs_to_the_OTHER_branch.reading: all 11 games are HIDDEN_STATE_GAME_IDS members. This statistic is a property of the hidden-state admission branch, which a hidden Kaggle game never takes. Carrying it onto the plain branch is the cross-branch transfer error, and it would have made the admit ceiling look bounded by a conjunct that does not apply.

NONDEGENERACY_CONJUNCT.consequence_for_the_admit_ceiling: The ceiling is bounded by the MARGIN DISTRIBUTION alone, not by a conjunct. That is the more permissive of the two possibilities -- and the ceiling is still tiny.

SCOPE_PLAIN_BRANCH_ONLY.why: HIDDEN_STATE_GAME_IDS is a hardcoded 11-game PUBLIC tuple. A hidden Kaggle game id is not a member, so a hidden game ALWAYS takes the plain (`else`) branch. Hidden-state results do not transfer and are excluded, not pooled.
SCOPE_PLAIN_BRANCH_ONLY.no_margin_is_MISSING_not_zero: these attempts never reached STAGE 4, so no verify_cell_recall was computed. They are excluded from every distribution and every count. Coercing them to 0.0 would deflate the mean and inflate the n.

MARGIN_DISTRIBUTION_plain_branch.between_arm_variance_is_the_dominant_eff: same 14 games, same generator config (n_ctx 81920), two independent samples: one arm yields three engines at or above 0.1985 and the other yields a maximum of 0.0476. The admit count per run is therefore bimodal, and a single arm's admit count is not a stable estimate of the ceiling.

ADMIT_COUNT_BY_THRESHOLD.gate_modelled: cell_recall >= t, threshold-only (no nondegeneracy conjunct, per Q2)
ADMIT_COUNT_BY_THRESHOLD.the_result_that_matters_most: EVERY engine admitted at any tested threshold comes from llm_on_fix_diag -- the arm that ran the SHIPPED `exact` metric. The arm that actually ran cell_recall admits ZERO at every threshold down to 0.10. So the configuration under test (metric=cell_recall) has no admitted engine anywhere in the record.

MIN_REACHABLE_P_STATED_IN_ADVANCE.why_game_not_engine: two engines from the same game share that game's corpus, prompt and stall state; they are not independent observations. Computing a bound at engine level while calling the unit a game overstates precision by the within-game multiplicity -- the error already present in the prior artifact's 0.1015.
MIN_REACHABLE_P_STATED_IN_ADVANCE.bottom_line: at a 0.20 gate the admitted set is 2 games, so the smallest attainable two-sided p is 0.5 and the smallest one-sided p is 0.25. No effect measured on this admitted set can reach p<0.05 at any threshold in the table -- five admitted games would be needed one-sided, six two-sided, and the maximum available at ANY threshold is three.

NECESSARY_NOT_SUFFICIENT_confirmed_on_th.what: engines that DID clear the shipped exact gate on the plain branch, and what the planner then did. Admission and planning are separate outcomes and are reported separately.
NECESSARY_NOT_SUFFICIENT_confirmed_on_th.reading: 2 of 14 plain attempts in the shipped-metric arm cleared the gate at accuracy 0.96 and 0.92, and BOTH produced no_reachable_plan_after_refinement -- zero plans. Their cell_recall is 0.0000, i.e. they are the no-op-inflated identity engines. Opening the gate wider converts a rejection into an ATTEMPT to plan, which is not the same as a plan.

limitations: This is a census over 28 recorded plain-branch margins from ONE 2026-07-27 run. The other 84 attempts of that run persisted no margin and are unknown, not zero.

The admitted engines are counterfactual: they were rejected in the run that produced them. Whether an engine at cell_recall 0.22 yields a plan is NOT measured here, and the two live engines that did clear a gate yielded none.
No episode was played, no level solved, no live win-rate effect measured.
The two arms are independent generator samples, so the pooled 28 mixes two draws of engine quality on the same 14 games; the pooled admit count is not what any single future run would produce.

cell_recall masks to TRUE changes only (ops/verifier_gaps.md GAP-WM-TRUST-GATE): it is recall, not fidelity, and is blind to an engine that writes cells reality never changed. Admitting on it at 0.20 admits spurious writers too.
headline: llm_on_fix_cellrecall ran at threshold 0.5 (a hardcoded literal; no threshold env exists) against an in-arm maximum cell_recall of 0.0476 -- 0 of 14 attempts could have been admitted, so its 0-plans result is VOID, not negative. The nondegeneracy conjunct does NOT gate this path (mutually exclusive if/elif), so the ceiling is set by margins alone: pooled over 28 plain-branch attempts on 14 games, a 0.20 gate admits 2 engines on 2 games -- all of them from the arm that ran the SHIPPED exact metric, none from the cell_recall arm. Minimum reachable two-sided p at 2 game clusters is 0.5.
proceed_recommendation_rationale: Not because nothing is admitted -- 2 engines on 2 games are -- and not because the nondegeneracy conjunct empties the set, which it does not. Because the admitted set cannot support any inference: 2 game clusters cap the two-sided p at 0.5, and the 3-game maximum available at ANY threshold in the table still caps it at 0.25. Separately, every admitted engine comes from the arm that ran the shipped `exact` metric, so the configuration actually under test has zero admitted engines in the entire record. The one action this analysis DOES support is the retraction in PRIOR_ARM_FORENSICS: the record currently says the cell_recall lever was tested and failed, and it was not tested at all.
what_would_change_this_answer: A fresh generator run is the only thing that can, and it is out of scope here (CPU-only, no GGUF). The cheap version is not 'lower the threshold and re-run the A/B' -- it is to instrument how many engines per run land in [0.15, 0.35] on cell_recall, because at 3 engines per 14 games the answer is that no A/B on this axis is powered, and that is worth knowing before any GPU time is spent.

C1_the_word_CEILING_is_WRONG_this_artifa.defect: This artifact is captioned a ceiling and its `ceiling` field reports ONLY the 28 LIVE in-episode margins. The artifact it corrects (outer_loop_arc_generation_vs_selection_20260802.json, written 29 minutes earlier) contains a LARGER, MORE PERMISSIVE measurement of the SAME gate that was not cited here: PRIMARY_the_gate_faithful_split.plain_cell_recall at threshold 0.50 = 61 clearing of 250 engines over 13 distinct games (24.4%), distribution median 0.0597 / q3 0.4658 / max 1.0. That artifact explicitly labels this corpus 'an UPPER BOUND on live engine quality ... used here as the generous case'. A CEILING claim is precisely the claim most damaged by omitting the generous case.
C1_the_word_CEILING_is_WRONG_this_artifa.corrected_ceiling_at_t_0.20: Between 24.4% and 50% of the 250 offline engines, over at least 13 games. Bounded not point-estimated: 24.4% clear at 0.50 so at least that many clear at 0.20 (monotonicity), and the median is 0.0597 < 0.20 so fewer than 50% clear. The exact count at 0.20 was not recomputed because the underlying engine corpus is another writer's in-flight untracked run (results/arc_inert_rejection_ab_20260801/) which this session read but must not depend on.
C1_the_word_CEILING_is_WRONG_this_artifa.the_two_numbers_are_different_POPULATION: LIVE FLOOR (what a live A/B would actually sample): 2 engines / 2 games at t=0.20 from 28 in-episode margins over 14 games. GENEROUS CEILING (offline, saved engines scored on a curated level-up-straddling window from a WINNING trajectory): >=61 engines / >=13 games at t=0.20 from 250. The prior artifact states the mechanism for the gap in its own words: 'the live gate scores _active_transitions() -- what the agent collected while STALLED ... The offline corpus is therefore easier on BOTH sides.'
C1_the_word_CEILING_is_WRONG_this_artifa.n_admitted_at_020_and_n_games_admitted_a: 2 and 2 remain correct AS LIVE-ARM FIGURES. Only the caption is corrected: they are a floor, not a ceiling.

C2_PARTIALLY_REJECTED_the_min_reachable_.reviewer_claim: The review asserted the sentence 'no effect measured on this admitted set can reach significance at any threshold' is REFUTED by the 13-game offline split (min two-sided p = 2/2**13 = 0.00024).
C2_PARTIALLY_REJECTED_the_min_reachable_.why_this_is_only_PARTIALLY_accepted: Read literally the sentence is scoped -- 'on this admitted set', and 'the maximum available at ANY threshold IN THE TABLE', where the table is the live pool. Within the live pool the arithmetic is right and reproduces: 2 game clusters -> min two-sided p 0.5; 3 -> 0.25; p<0.05 needs 5 one-sided / 6 two-sided. That sentence is NOT false and is not withdrawn.
C2_PARTIALLY_REJECTED_the_min_reachable_.what_IS_accepted: The DEFECT is the caption and the omission (C1), not that sentence. An artifact titled a ceiling that silently reports only the least permissive population invites exactly the reading the reviewer took. Both populations are now stated side by side.

C3_proceed_recommended_STAYS_FALSE_but_t.original_reason_now_insufficient_on_its_: 'the admitted set cannot support any inference' -- true of the live pool, but incomplete, because it never mentions that a more permissive population exists and admits 13 games.
C3_proceed_recommended_STAYS_FALSE_but_t.corrected_reason_1_live_admit_rate: A live A/B samples from LIVE inductions, not from saved offline engines. At t=0.20 the live rate is 2/28 engines = 2/14 games. A fresh 14-game run would expect ~2 admitted games; 6 are needed for a two-sided p<0.05. Underpowered by construction, not by bad luck.
C3_proceed_recommended_STAYS_FALSE_but_t.corrected_reason_2_the_admitted_engines_: The generous 61 are not usable engines. The same artifact's PAIRED_generalisation_of_the_strongest_engines re-scores the 15 that are BOTH high-recall (>=0.5) and high-precision (>=0.9) on 120 fresh rows: 0 of 15 survive, change_accuracy 0.0000, and on 4 of their 5 games a stateless engine could provably score 1.0. So widening the gate to admit them admits engines already measured not to transfer.
C3_proceed_recommended_STAYS_FALSE_but_t.corrected_reason_3_cost: Per the sibling blast-radius artifact, each admission costs up to 80 unchecked actions (20% of the 400-action scored budget) with NO divergence check anywhere between admission and the environment, and 6 of 14 games kept firing 16-64 actions into a GAME_OVER state.
C3_proceed_recommended_STAYS_FALSE_but_t.what_would_flip_it: Not a lower threshold. A generator whose LIVE margins clear the bar -- i.e. movement in the live margin distribution, whose current max over 28 attempts is 0.2474.
